title: Fix Jap Section Bugs, Smooth Nam Jap Counting & Add Progress Bar

requirements.text: Fix all bugs in the Jap section (frontend/src/pages/Jap.tsx): resolve any state management issues causing incorrect or inconsistent nam jap count display, fix tap handler debouncing or double-counting problems, ensure the session count and daily count both update correctly and reliably on every tap/press, and prevent any race conditions between local state and backend sync that cause the counter to skip, reset unexpectedly, or display stale values.

quotes: in counting the nam jap it faces many problems it doesn't count the nam jap smoothly

acceptanceCriteria: Every single tap/press increments the displayed nam jap count by exactly 1 with no skips or double-counts
Session count and daily count remain consistent with each other and do not reset unexpectedly mid-session
Rapid repeated taps are handled gracefully without freezing, skipping counts, or crashing
Backend sync does not override or revert the locally displayed count while the user is actively chanting
Milestone effects (ripple, lotus bloom at 108) trigger at the correct count values

requirements.text: Implement smooth, lag-free nam jap counting in the Jap section: use optimistic local state updates (increment a local ref or state immediately on tap before any async backend call) so the counter visually increments instantly without waiting for backend responses. Debounce or batch backend sync calls so frequent taps do not trigger excessive re-renders or network requests that cause UI jank.

quotes: it doesn't count the nam jap smoothly so solve it

acceptanceCriteria: The counter number updates visually within 16ms (one animation frame) of each tap
No visible stutter, lag, or delay when tapping rapidly
Backend sync is batched/debounced and does not cause the counter to flicker or temporarily revert

requirements.text: Add a circular or linear progress bar to the Jap section (frontend/src/pages/Jap.tsx) that fills progressively as the nam jap count increases toward the 108-bead cycle. The progress bar should visually represent progress from 0 to 108 (one mala), reset and refill for each subsequent mala cycle, and display the current count and target (e.g., '45 / 108') alongside it. Use saffron/gold devotional colors consistent with the app theme.

quotes: add a progress bar it fills when the nam jap increasing

acceptanceCriteria: A progress bar is visible on the Jap page that fills from 0% to 100% as the count goes from 0 to 108
Progress bar resets and refills for each new 108-count mala cycle
Current count and target (e.g., '45 / 108') are displayed near the progress bar
Progress bar color uses saffron or gold tones matching the app's devotional theme
Progress bar updates smoothly and instantly in sync with each tap

constraints: Do not modify files under frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.ts, frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts, frontend/src/main.tsx, or frontend/src/components/ui
Backend Motoko actor in backend/main.mo should only be changed if a schema or logic fix is strictly required for correct counting; prefer frontend-side fixes first
Preserve all existing visual effects: SacredRipple, OmParticleBurst, LotusBloomOverlay, and MalaRing
nonGoals: Redesigning the entire Jap page layout
Adding new mantras or changing mantra selection logic
Modifying any other pages (Home, Panchang, Aarti, etc.)
Changing the backend data model for jap counters unless strictly necessary
